normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only used inside transfer() to gate on _lp and to receive the tokens.
amount is only consumed by transfer() as the value forwarded to _transfer.
sender is only used by transferFrom() as the debited account.
spender is only used by approve() to key the allowance mapping.
newOwner is only written to _owner inside transferOwnership().
account is only used by _burn() to select the balance to decrement.
burnAmount is the direct result of the mul/div burn arithmetic in _transfer.
remainingAmount is a scratch value used only for the balance update in _transfer.
the admin-supplied recipient is only written into _lp inside setLP().
the cached msgSender local is just the return value of _msgSender() used to initialise _owner.
snapshotId is only consumed by the snapshot query helper surface.
